short: power inlet: VBUS->TVS->bulk->+VIN; CC pair to FUSB302
long: PD power inlet: keep the VBUS path (receptacle -> TVS -> bulk -> +VIN) in one corner so the +VIN plane spreads from a single point; CC1/CC2 route to the FUSB302 (usb_pd block, anchored next to this inlet). PLAN.md round 5: a TPS25940-class eFuse lands between receptacle and bulk — reserve space for it here.

short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.
JTAG (2x7 2 mm) + SWD (2x5 1.27 mm) headers mate vertically — any top-side spot works; keep cable/probe clearance and the boot DIP reachable.

short: 2 bucks: thermal copper + vias; keep SW loops tight
long: Buck thermal (worst-case declared draws): LM61460AANRJRR +5V_REG ~0.03 W; LM61460AANRJRR +3V3_REG ~0.02 W. Pour copper on the SW/PGND side, stitch vias under the packages, keep each SW node loop minimal.

short: INA3221 shunts sit IN the rail path
long: Power monitor: the shunt resistors are in series with the rails — the rails must physically route through this block; place it between the regulators and the loads, Kelvin-connect the sense pairs.

short: USB-UART conn deferred; TPs on TX/RX
long: CP2102N UART bridge: its USB connector is an author-declared deferral (expect usb_uart_connector) — the block reserves edge space for it; TX/RX test points stay probe-able.
18 test points board-wide (test-point gate): spread them with probe clearance as the blocks settle; none may end up under the SoM.
